title: Coefficient passage for specified operation exchanges
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a field $k$ with $\ell$ invertible, finite-type $k$-schemes $X,Y$ [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], and a separated finite-type $k$-map $f:X\to Y$. Let $g_X,g_Y$ be scheme automorphisms, without a $k$-linearity requirement. A support recipe is either the commuting square $g_Xf=fg_Y$ or a chosen compactification $c=(j,p)$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], an endomorphism of its middle term, its commuting proper square and Cartesian open square [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square]. Use the integral direct-image and fixed-compactification exchanges constructed in [def-weil-system-operation-exchange-realization], on the integral constructible categories [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], and the specified integral and rational pullbacks [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom].

For every finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, define the rational source and target using literal scalar localization [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi] of these integral operations, retaining the recorded compact-support functor and the same $c$ [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support]. Define their rational exchange as the localized integral exchange on each integral representative and on the raw localized Hom modules. For each embedding of finite coefficient fields, construct the operation coefficient comparison from the actual whole-system direct-image or proper/open scalar mate and normalized reduction/limit counits [lem-fix-operation-reduction], and the pullback comparison from its recorded scalar normalization. Combine these in source and target order. Localize these comparisons; they give the actual transition isomorphisms at the finite subfields of an algebraic closure [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients], including identity inclusions and the full tower cocycle. Define the common-stage exchange by applying the canonical compatible-transformation descent [prop-weil-pbc-descent-functors] to this family. Its component at $(E,K)$ is the morphism class of the localized integral exchange at $E$, with naturality on every common-stage representative. No exchange or coefficient comparison is an input to this construction.

For finite coefficients, use the ambient mate [def-weil-pbc-ambient-ringed-exchange] and the proper/open recipe [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed], with the canonical open-square comparison [lem-trf-open-square-exchange]. For the witnessed etale-origin domain, pull back the retained antecedent and its comparison by [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback], preserving its lower bound. Transport the finite compact exchange from $c$ to $d$ by the actual comparisons of [prop-compactification-coherence-detailed]: pull back $C_{d,c}$, apply the $c$-exchange, and apply the inverse comparison at the specified pulled witness. For the finite-field datum [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], use its actual fiber map [def-zl-weil-ind-sheaf-category] and coefficient Frobenius [def-weil-frobenius-detailed]; its direct finite exchange is the ambient mate of [lem-weil-frobenius-square-cartesian]. All maps are natural transformations; no final exchange invertibility or compactification independence is asserted.

The intrinsic coordinate presentation retains every etale-origin antecedent and its canonical realization comparison. Its pairwise comparison is uniquely normalized by the proper-composition/proper-open refinement formula; on a recorded finite-level witnessed object it equals the recorded refinementComparisonIsomorphism [def-sf-refinement-comparison-isomorphism], conjugated by the canonical open and direct-image realization comparisons. These coordinate helpers belong to this construction and do not replace the recorded compactification coherence theorem.

proof.text: Publicly re-export the finite-origin section from FrobeniusWitnessedCompactification. Its public names, signatures, construction formulas, completed normalization proofs and the existing named intrinsic coherence obligation are retained. This self-contained relocation is required for the per-file compile limit after local definition-opacity improvements.

Keep the recorded origin, compactification, finite exchange, integral exchange, coefficient mate, and common-stage constructions. The intrinsic compactification coherence obligation is retained in the extracted witnessed module; the two stage compatibility laws retain their existing named proof obligations and original docstring arguments. Operation coefficient invertibility follows by the component arguments below.

Prove the raw localized Hom identity and composition laws by tensor induction, using ScalarLocalization.composition_tmul and the original integral functor laws. A second tensor induction transports integral naturality to every localized Hom. The private localizedFunctor_comp repeats tensor induction to prove literal compatibility with composition.

Apply uniqueness in rationalDerivedPullback_existsUnique to the localized pullback: its object map is unchanged, its Hom map is additive, and LinearMap.baseChange_tmul proves the required pure-tensor formula. Prove modelLinear by the directImage_linear and sfCompactSupportFiniteIntegralFunctor_linear declarations. Compose the two additive linear factors to prove modelSource_linear and modelTarget_linear. The private composition identity and localizedPullback_eq then prove modelRationalSource_eq and modelRationalTarget_eq; both support recipes have the prescribed literal tensor extension.

Construct pullScalar_existsUnique componentwise from integralPullbackScalarComparison. Restrict scalarCompletion to the constructible category, where it is an isomorphism. Whisker its inverse by integral pullback, compose the ordinary scalar/pullback natural isomorphism, and whisker scalarCompletion by target pullback. This composite proves naturality of the prescribed completed components. Componentwise extensionality proves uniqueness.

For modelRationalScalar_existsUnique, use the private scalar-localization isomorphism construction underlying scalar-extension composition. Its pure-tensor characterization gives the localized source and target functor formulas. Localize the actual integral modelSideScalar, prove naturality by the tensor formula, and use componentwise extensionality for uniqueness. Apply modelRationalSource_eq or modelRationalTarget_eq according to the side.

Restrict integralDerivedPullback_linear to the constructible full subcategory. For addition and scalar multiplication separately, apply ObjectProperty.hom_ext and then the corresponding ambient map_add or map_smul equality. This proves pullback_linear for the same specified functor without new hypotheses or constructions. In modelSource_linear and modelTarget_linear, expose only the named composite before synthesizing the additive and linear instances for its specified factors, avoiding inference of unspecified composite factors.

For modelScalarMap_isIso, split the retained SupportModel. In the direct branch apply the component-level direct-image coefficient exchange invertibility. In the compact branch apply sfCompactSupportCoefficientExchange_isIso to the middle whole-system coefficient map; the surrounding compactRealization components are isomorphisms. Map the source component isomorphism through scalar extension, compose it with asIso of the existing middle component proof, then compose with the inverse target component. The hom of this explicit composite is definitionally the specified compact coefficient map. In each branch ObjectProperty.isIso_hom_iff lifts component invertibility to the full constructible subcategory, and NatIso.isIso_of_isIso_app lifts it to the natural transformation. No Frobenius hypothesis is used in coefficient invertibility, and no new coefficient map is chosen.

Private proved helpers supply scalar-conjugation naturality and generic tensor-localization calculations. No new hypotheses or proof dependencies. D4 stage-3 partial proof, 2026-10-26: pullback_linear follows by full-subcategory morphism extensionality from integralDerivedPullback_linear; all other constructions and remaining obligations are retained. D2, 2026-10-27: modelScalarMap_isIso is reduced by a complete two-case proof to the existing compact-support coefficient component lemma and one new direct-image coefficient component lemma. The latter is strictly the direct branch and is independent of Frobenius, rational localization and the stage system. The three other original holes remain. The specialized localization-composition proof uses direct tensor induction and local opacity avoids repeated expansion of the tensor composition constructor. The independent finite-origin section is relocated unchanged to FrobeniusWitnessedCompactification after optimized full-module delivery preflight still took 63 seconds. Its declarations are publicly re-exported and their node attachment moves to the new extraction node. The original coherence hole is relocated, not added or closed.
